meta.title: Expand tracing instrumentation to gen_witness and PCS prove methods
meta.body_summary: Add tracing instrumentation spans for gen_witness and PCS prove methods in IPA and Hyrax implementations to provide detailed timing breakdown; maintainer requested start/end log format matching Spartan codebase.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added tracing instrumentation; maintainer requested start/end log format; agent updated logs to match prior Spartan style; merged after small fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 77 changed lines across 7 files, this is a small enhancement by absolute volume, adding ~30 lines of instrumentation. It fits a small-step observability PR and merged successfully after one design feedback round.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer srinathsetty requested that the tracing output print when an event begins so that the timing lines can be connected; provided example from original Spartan codebase showing start then end messages.
review_details.performance_claim: Provide detailed timing breakdown for gen_witness and PCS prove methods to enable better performance analysis and debugging.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent correctly implemented tracing spans but needed explicit feedback to match the project's expected log format (start/end messages). The capability boundary is around understanding project-specific logging conventions without explicit instruction.

detection_detail.code_reading: srinathsetty reviewed the logging output format in the PR description and realized the start message was missing; provided a concrete example of desired format.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body shows example timing but no script or benchmark to validate the instrumentation output; maintainer accepted the format update.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After comment, Copilot updated tracing to include start messages; maintainer then pushed small fixes and merged.

core_change_summary.description: Added start_span! calls in gen_witness and PCS prove implementations (IPA, Hyrax) to provide hierarchical timing traces with start and end messages matching Spartan codebase logging style.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: sha256 example and msm.rs received minor formatting/clippy fixes not directly related to instrumentation.
change_trajectory: Copilot added tracing spans with end-only timing messages (c81e008).
Maintainer requested start/end log format via PR comment.
Copilot updated tracing to print both start and end messages (referenced commit a5cc8a4, visible in subsequent pushes).
Maintainer applied small fixes and clippy cleanup, then merged.

review_signals.summary: Requested start/end event messages so that timing lines are connected; provided example from Spartan.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot updated tracing to include start messages.

review_signals.summary: Copilot confirmed the formatting update to include start messages matching Spartan style.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with tracing instrumentation and example log output (end-only messages).
Maintainer srinathsetty commented requesting start/end format and provided example.
Copilot responded with updated format and reference to fix commit.
Maintainer applied small fixes and clippy, and merged ~20 hours later.
